name: jinx-harness
description: Give any model hands. Self-hosted 24/7 Telegram agent runtime with a built-in MCP client — bring any OpenAI-compatible provider, connect any Model Context Protocol server (plain, API-key or OAuth login), let the agent connect new servers itself with a human permission gate, deploy to shared hosting with one zip and a one-time web wizard. No build, no npm install, no telemetry.
